newsitem.title: USA: American Real Estate files rights offering.
newsitem.headline: American Real Estate files rights offering.

text.p: American Real Estate Partners LP said Friday it has filed a proposed $300 million rights offering to holders of its depository units.
The money to be raised under the offering is expected to be used primarily for additional investment opportunities, the company said.
The company said it anticipates that the record date for the offering will be September 1997, with holders as of that date being issued one transferrable right for each five depository units held.
Each right will allow the holder to acquire from the company four depository units and one 5 percent cumulative pay-in-kind redeemable preferred unit.
